content: Usaia Nanmwarkien Suda
Mehn Suda koaros pilada sapwellimen Amasaia pwutak Usaia, me sounpar eisek weneu, pwehn wiliandi semeo uhd wiahla nanmwarki.
(Mwurin sipalahn Amasaia me Usaia pwurehng kalowehdi Elad oh onehda sapahl kahnimwo.)
Usaia wiahla nanmwarki ni eh sounpar eisek weneu, oh e kakaunki nan Serusalem erein sounpar limeisek riau. Eh nohno iei Sekolaia, mehn Serusalem.
E kalamangih karasepen semeo, e wiadahr dahme kaparanda kupwur en KAUN-O.
Erein Sekaraia, sapwellime sounkaweid en lamalam, eh wie momour, e kin ketin papah KAUN-O ni loalopwoat, oh Koht ketin kupwuramwahwihala.
Usaia mahweniong mehn Pilisdia. E ketin kauwehla kelen kahnimw kan en Kad, Samnia, oh Asdod, oh kauwada kahnimw kei me kehl kehlail limwahn Asdod oh wasa teikan nan Pilisdia.
Koht ketin sewese pwehn kalowehdi mehn Pilisdia kan, oh mehn Arepia kan me koukousoan nan Kurpaal, oh mehn Meun kan.
Mehn Ammon kan kin nohpweiong Usaia, oh eh manaman laudla me kahrehda eh ndand lohkpeseng lellahng nan Isip.
Usaia kakehlailihala kelen mahwen kan en Serusalem ni eh kauwada wasahn iroir kei ni keimw en Ewen Kelen Keimw, ni Ewen Kelen Wahu, oh wasa me kehlo wet ie.

E pil ketin kauwada wasahn iroir kei en mahwen nan sahpw patapato oh weirada wasahn nahk pihl, pwehki eh sapwellimaniki mahn tohto ni palikapi en tepin dohl kan oh nan sahpw patapat akan. Pwehki eh kupwurperenki doadoahk en mwetuwel, e pil koangngoangehki aramas akan en wiahda mwetin wain kan ni sahpw nahnahno oh re en wiahda mwetuwel nan sahpw pwelmwahwo.

E ahpw ketin kaunopada karis en sounpei tohto me onopadahr ong mahwen. Sapwellime sounnting Seiel, oh Maaseaia me kin nekinekid sapwellime kisinlikou kan en mwekid en wehi pahn epwelpen Ananaia, emen kisehn sapwellimen nanmwarkio tohndoadoahk.
Lapalap 2,600 me kaunda kariso.
Me mi pahrail iei sounpei 307,500 me koahiek en mahweniong sapwellimen nanmwarkio imwintihti kan ni mwaren nanmwarkio.
Usaia kin ketikihong sounpei ko dipwisoun mahwen me iangahki mehn sansar, ketieu, lisoarop, mehn kidikid mete, kesik ketieu oh arep, oh takai en pahi.

Sapwellime sounwia dipwisoun mahwen kan wiahda mehn kesingki ketieu oh mehn kadarala takai sang pohn wasahn iroir kan oh ni keimw kan en kelen kahnimwo. Eh ndand ahpw lohkseli wasa koaros, oh sapwellime manaman pil laudla mehlel, pwehki sawas me Koht ketikihong.
Usaia ketin Ale Lokolok pwehki Eh Aklapalap

Ahpw ni ahnsou me Usaia kehlaillahr, e ahpw aklapalapala, oh met kahrehiong eh pwupwudi. E mwamwahlikihla KAUN-O eh Koht, ni eh ketilong nan Tehnpas Sarawio pwehn isik warpwohmwahu pohn pei sarawien warpwohmwahwo.
Samworo Asaraia, iangahki samworo kehlail oh poadidi weliakan, ahpw idawehnla nanmwarkio

pwe re en kapweiekidi. Re patohwan, “Usaia! Komwi sohte sapwellimaniki pwung en isik warpwohmwahu ong KAUN-O. Samworo kan me kadaudok en Aaron iei irailte me kasarawihongehr doadoahk wet. Komwi ketieisang wasa sarawi wet. Komwi ketin dipadahr ong KAUN- O, oh solahr sapwellime kupwuramwahu ong komwi.”

Usaia ketiket nan Tehnpas Sarawio limwahn pei sarawien warpwohmwahwo oh kolokol mehn isik warpwohmwahu ehu. E ahpw engiengda pahn samworo ko, oh ni ahnsowohte soumwahu en kihl ehu pwarada pohn temweo.
Asaraia oh samworo teiko eri kilangada kihlo pohn isilap en nanmwarkio oh masakada, re ahpw idingohng en ketieisang nan Tehnpas Sarawio. E ahpw mwadangete ketieila, pwehki KAUN-O eh ketin kalokeier.

Nanmwarkio saminla ong kaudok erein eh mour, pwehki luhmwuhmwo. E sohla kak pwurehng ketilong nan Tehnpas Sarawio, e kin ketiket nan pein tehnpese, kommoaldihsang pwukoa koaros, nindokon sapwellime pwutak Sodam me uhd kakaun wehio.
Soukohp Aiseia nein Eimwos, ntingihedi soahng teikan me Nanmwarki Usaia wiadahr erein sapwellime mwehi.
Usaia sipalla oh seridi wasahn seridi en nanmwarki kan, ahpw pwehki luhmwuhmwo, kahrehda eh sohte seridi nan sousoun nanmwarki kan. Sapwellime pwutak Sodam me uhd wiliandi wiahla nanmwarki.
